messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU queue growth threshold exceeded for gpu-pool-prod (queue length 118k, 5m rate +320%). Pager sent to @oncall_jess. Metrics: https://rwd-monitoring.company/alerts/2123456789

miguel: seeing huge spike in batching jobs, CPU ok but GPUs saturated. latency p50 -> 2.1s, p95 -> 12s, many requests hitting `503` from frontdoor.

oncall_jess: got the page — jumping in. can folks paste the runbook link?

infra_matt: runbook: https://rwd-runbooks/internal/gpu_pool_autoscale. quick summary: autoscaler hit maxNodes for pool (maxNodes=50), kube HPA/cluster-autoscaler refusing further scale.

miguel: confirmed. Autoscaler events show "max nodes reached" for last 11 minutes. backlog growing; retry storms from clients.

ops_lead_raj: are we seeing node provisioning failures or just hard cap?

infra_matt: it's a hard cap on the cloud account for that node-pool. quota is set to 50 by policy. Cloud provider quota already at 50. Need manual cap bump or temporary quota increase.

oncall_jess: what's the impact window? which customers?

support_kim: noticed 4 customers with >20% error rate since 09:12 UTC. Incident has triggered CS escalations.

miguel: example request queue snapshot: 118k queued, processing throughput steady but insufficient. Estimated time to clear if no action ~ 4+ hours.

ops_lead_raj: proposal: manual cap raise to 58 nodes to absorb backlog and give autoscaler room to operate; plan to roll back to 50 once backlog <5k. Any objections?

oncall_jess: +1 from oncall. Need approval from infra to raise and ops to execute. Also we should enable temporary conservative rate-limiting for new requests to avoid refilling queue.

infra_matt: I can request a quota bump but cloud support SLA is ~30-45m. For immediate relief we can do a manual pool override in our control plane (temp maxNodes override) — will need on-call and ops signoff. Command: `rwdctl pools update gpu-pool-prod --override-max 58 --reason "incident 2123456789"`

miguel: also consider fallbacks: route low-priority inference to cpu-backed fallback model and set `x-retry-after` headers for clients.

support_kim: communicating to impacted customers now: templated message queued, include ETA ~30-45m for mitigation and invite to priority queue if applicable.

ops_lead_raj: executing manual override in 2m. oncall_jess you'll need to ack when nodes start joining. I will open a tracking ticket: INC-2123456789 (manual-cap-bump).

oncall_jess: ack. standing by.

infra_matt: running: 
``` 
# dry-run show
rwdctl pools get gpu-pool-prod --show-config
# apply override
rwdctl pools update gpu-pool-prod --override-max 58 --reason "incident 2123456789"
``` 

ops_lead_raj: override applied. cloud API accepted, new target max=58. provisioning started. ETA nodes join ~6-9m.

miguel: seeing nodes in Pending->Ready. p95 latency dropping a bit already (12s -> 9s). backlog down to 84k.

oncall_jess: good sign. keep an eye on spike loops. Are we throttling retries?

miguel: added temporary per-customer token bucket at the edge: `rate_limit=30rpm` for affected plans. Should reduce incoming load.

support_kim: updated customers with mitigation steps and told them we'll follow up with timeline and postmortem.

ops_lead_raj: nodes stabilized, current node count 56/58. backlog now 42k. autoscaler resumed normal ops.

oncall_jess: what's the rollback plan? we agreed to revert to 50 once backlog <5k and steady for 10m. who will execute?

infra_matt: I'll schedule an automated rollback job: `rwdctl pools update gpu-pool-prod --override-max 50 --when-backlog-lt 5000 --stable-for 600` (note: operator action still required to finalize; will send intent here).

miguel: logged the mitigation actions and metrics to the incident channel. will add traces and sample requests to the incident artifact bucket: gs://rwd-incidents/2123456789/

ops_lead_raj: deconflicting note: make sure no ongoing deploys touch the pool. tagging repo: `infra/overrides` with PR link soon.

support_kim: customers acknowledge update; one large customer switched some traffic to Dedicated capacity and saw immediate improvement.

oncall_jess: handing off to infra_matt for monitoring and rollback once stable. I'm going off-call in 30m but will monitor notifications.

infra_matt: accepted handoff. I'll keep watch for metrics and kick the rollback once conditions met. I'll also open a cloud support case for permanent quota increase request and attach incident logs.

ops_lead_raj: post-incident actions: 1) request permanent quota bump to 80 nodes for pool; 2) add autoscaler safety margin (reserve 6 nodes headroom) 3) add better backpressure on API surface; 4) postmortem draft assigned to miguel.

miguel: I'll draft postmortem and include sequence, decision timeline, customer impact, and remediation.

support_kim: prepping customer summary and next steps for CS.

oncall_jess: thanks team. marking this thread as monitoring — will update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
